Name: Labels for Better Honey Mead
Author: niedroProg
Description:
This is a simple texture replacement to make a label being coloured instead of the entire mead contents. I made this because I don't like how the colouring method handles the mead (it works well with grayscale sprites, not so much with colours).

[b]Installation instructions:

[/b]Just extract the folder into Mods (or wherever your "[CP] Better Honey Mead" folder is) and let it override the original PNG file.
